upgrades.name: Recruits
upgrades.effect: +{value} apprentice at the start per level

staffs.name: Ember
staffs.blurb: A splash of flame on every hit.
staffs.tier2: Evolved: burns for 30% of the hit over 2 s.

staffs.name: Storm
staffs.blurb: A bolt that leaps between blocks.
staffs.tier2: Evolved: the bolt chains one more target.

staffs.name: Frost
staffs.blurb: Slows what it hits, shatters what it kills.
staffs.tier2: Evolved: the shatter hits neighbours within 1 m for 50%.

sanctum.heading: Sanctum
sanctum.name: Wisp
sanctum.blurb: A spark that hovers beside the squad and hunts the nearest thing on the road.
tiers: Bound: a homing spark on its own clock.
Tier 2: sparks come faster and land harder.
Tier 3: a spark a second, and it hurts.

entries.name: Grunt
entries.blurb: One skeleton of the river. Hundreds follow it.

entries.name: Brute
entries.blurb: A block that walks. Break it before it arrives.

entries.name: Demon
entries.blurb: The horned thing at the road's end. It stomps.

entries.name: Rimehound
entries.blurb: It waits in its lane, then runs it down. Shoot it, or be in another lane.

entries.name: Bulwark
entries.blurb: A brute behind a slab of ice. Its number will not move until the shield does.

entries.name: Rime Fiend
entries.blurb: The white giant at the far end of Frostfell. It stomps, and then it charges.
